title: polypogon × subaristatus
intro: Polypogon × subaristatus, commonly known as hybrid or cutleaf fleabane, is a plant hybrid resulting from the cross between Polypogon monspeliensis and Dactylis glomerata. This plant has been studied for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Polypogon × subaristatus include wound healing, antifungal, and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
